normative_requirements.statement: No evidence originating as a fixture, simulation, declaration, unchecked hash, browser policy, expired delegation, stale receipt, or unknown external outcome can be promoted into a live, authorized, observed, current production-success claim.
Evidence is a product of origin/integrity/authority/policy/proof/freshness/effect/environment/review dimensions; never a single total ladder.
Every effectful operation uses closed outcomes Unavailable|Rejected|Simulated|Attempted|Unknown|Observed|Verified|Failed|Compensated; generic success:true is forbidden on migrated production paths.
Kernel defines production_supported, effect_successful, proof_reusable, receipt_authoritative, and release_admissible predicates.

Fixture cannot become live observation by relabeling; digest cannot establish semantic truth; payment cannot grant authority; cached proof candidate cannot become admitted without current verifier evidence; browser policy cannot affect host authorization except through authenticated request fields.
Use deterministic DAG-CBOR for signed persisted artifacts; reject unknown normative fields and duplicate keys; pin one CID profile per artifact family.
Every operation follows Proposed->...->ReceiptSealed typestate; only the kernel constructs AdmissionToken; unknown policy fails closed.

IPA detects import-time installation/network/process/mutation, mock-to-production flow, success without effect observation, exception swallowing, and pseudo-CID construction with source-to-sink traces.
Information-flow labels from Public through CryptographicSecret/WitnessSecret with explicit declassification; no raw secret or host path reaches browser payloads.

Fixed repair grammars for false success, mock capability, pseudo-CID, import effect, browser authority, mutable dependencies, stale proof reuse, and missing recovery states; LLMs cannot expand grammar or create authority.

ReleaseAdmissible requires exact source, immutable dependency closure, identified build environment, current proofs/tests/capabilities, contract compatibility, rights resolution, reproducibility, and signed provenance; ambiguous legal questions remain human-blocked.

Hard floors are zero for simulated-to-live promotion, effects without admission token, stale proof reuse, browser-authored authority, pseudo-CID on supported paths, release with mutable dependencies, success without observed/verified evidence, secret flow to public evidence, blind retry of unknown irreversible effects, and LLM self-certification.

normative_requirements.statement: Lean 4 owns normative claim semantics; Rust owns executable trusted kernel; TLA+/Alloy/Souffle/Z3/cvc5 are admitted for protocols/analysis/proof; Python/TS are not whole-program proof targets.
Inventories bind exact commits/gitlinks and source spans and cover every seeded defect without treating discovery as completion.
The supervisor executes only against exact committed gitlinks in its clean controller worktree and must not consume a dirty legacy checkout as source authority.
Day-90 gate: no browser authority, false success, pseudo-CID, import mutation, or mock promotion on the four migrated paths.
Terminal release composes SwissKnife request -> host admission -> Datasets translation -> Accelerate observed execution -> Kit persistence -> SwissKnife presentation with a proof-carrying receipt.
Plan, objectives, todo, scheduler, validator, and supervisor wrapper are protected control artifacts after FACP-000.
